01 / ASSUMPTIONS

Build your scenario

These inputs are chosen assumptions. The data do not estimate them.

PD: chance of default over one year.

LGD: share of exposure lost after a default.

0% removes the shock. 100% uses the reference stress. This is not a GDP forecast.

How severity changes PD and LGD

For severity s, the reference PD multiplier m becomes 1 + s × (m − 1). The reference LGD uplift u becomes s × u. Stressed PD and LGD are capped at 100%.

The reference multipliers are 2× for manufacturing and remaining industries, and 3× for construction and real estate. LGD rises by 5, 5, 10 and 15 percentage points respectively.

OBSERVED

Official lending balances

Bank of Finland data cover domestic non-financial corporations, excluding housing corporations, reported by MFIs excluding Bank of Finland. All currencies are expressed in euros. Remaining industries are a heterogeneous residual, including unclassified industries.

ASSUMED

A mechanism, with uncertainty

Weaker activity can raise default risk; more difficult recoveries can raise LGD. Their numerical effects here are assumptions. Statistics Finland bankruptcy counts provide historical context in the Python notebook; they do not calibrate PD.

LIMITS

A loss proxy on loan stocks

Existing non-performing balances are retained and not separately modelled. Stocks are fixed EAD proxies. Results are conditional illustrations, not a forecast, Nordea portfolio estimate, IFRS 9 provision or regulatory capital calculation.
